pack.risks: unvalidated idea; tiny DEMO risk only

concerns: Truncated method description leaves the data-capture mechanism, cost model, and comparison design unspecified
Ambiguity between 'hypothetical entry/exit' shadow logging and falsification language about 'exploration trades' - must confirm zero order_send() calls from the study under all branches
Raw net expectancy alone cannot distinguish a miscalibrated threshold from a correctly protective one; risk-adjusted comparison (variance, tail loss, drawdown profile) is required
Selection bias: abstained candidates occur under different regime/confidence conditions than executed trades; without matched-opportunity conditioning, outcome differences are confounded
Two weeks of low-confidence validated states may produce too few abstentions for statistical power; no minimum-sample or interim-checkpoint criterion is pre-registered
Affected files include bot/ai_council/ - proposal must guarantee no changes to champion promotion logic, trading YAML, or gate thresholds as part of this experiment
Hypothetical fills need an explicitly defined cost basis (decision-time spread plus slippage assumption), applied identically to both arms
votes.reason: The core idea is sound and policy-aligned: reconciling abstention behavior against counterfactual outcomes is exactly the kind of calibration evidence the validated-state gate lacks, and a shadow study in MT5 DEMO with no champion impact fits the research-only mandate. However, the submitted spec is incomplete (method text is truncated mid-sentence) and internally ambiguous: the method describes purely hypothetical logging of abstained candidates, while the tests and falsification criteria reference 'exploration trades' and 'exploration lifecycle,' leaving unclear whether any actual DEMO orders would ever be placed by or derived from this study. Research components must never call mt5.order_send(), so that boundary must be made explicit before approval. Additionally, 'equal or better net expectancy' is insufficient to conclude the confidence threshold is miscalibrated rather than protective - equal raw expectancy with lower tail risk or variance still justifies abstention.
requested_revisions: Complete the method section end-to-end: where candidates are captured, the hypothetical fill model, exit rules mirroring the executed-trade lifecycle, and the exact comparison statistic

Add an explicit read-only-broker guarantee: the study issues no orders, modifies no positions, and its outputs feed research reports only, with any future execution change requiring a separate governed proposal
Pre-register a risk-adjusted primary endpoint (e.g., EV per unit of tail loss on matched opportunity sets) instead of raw equal-or-better expectancy
Define a minimum abstention sample size and an interim checkpoint; if N is below threshold at week two, declare inconclusive or extend rather than conclude
Register the experiment in ExperimentRegistry with hypothesis, gates, and rollback (data purge plus config revert) before any data collection begins
Confirm via diff review that no changes touch PROTECTED_LIVE_YAML, promote.py gates, or intelligent_champion.json write paths

votes.reason: A DEMO-only, read-only shadow study is acceptable in principle, but the proposal lacks sufficient operational detail to verify it cannot affect execution or produce biased conclusions.

Register the single experiment before collection and confirm outputs cannot alter champion selection or risk parameters.
